category_title: Students exhibiting explicit acts of misbehavior and physical aggression
scenario_title: Disrespect and challenging authority during instructions
minimal_context: The student is in a high school English class being asked to settle down and open their notebook for instructions during the last ten minutes of the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take your seats and open your notebooks so I can give you the instructions for the last ten minutes of class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Talking loudly to a classmate) I'm not doing any in-class work right now, I didn't even do the homework.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to settle down and listen to the instructions now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why? The last ten minutes is the only time we have left, I'm not following any more instructions today.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You still need to be seated and follow the instructions I give you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Relax, viejo. You're taking this too seriously, just let us talk.
